operations.description: Converts an uploaded image in common formats such as JPEG, PNG into lines/text with location information and other metdata via Optical Character Recognition.  This API is intended to be run on scanned documents.  If you want to OCR photos (e.g. taken with a smart phone camera), be sure to use the photo/toText API instead, as it is designed to unskew the image first.
operations.summary: Convert a scanned image into words with location
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] image ocr image lines with location [PATH] ocr image to lines with location [PARAMS] language preprocessing [SCHEMA] element image line lines location ocr result to with word

operations.description: Analyzes a photograph of a business card as input, and outputs key business information such as the name of the person, name of the business, the address of the business, the phone number, the email address and more.
operations.summary: Recognize a photo of a business card, extract key business information
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] image ocr photo recognize business card [PATH] ocr photo recognize business card [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] business card recognition result

operations.description: Analyzes a photograph of a receipt as input, and outputs key business information such as the name of the business, the address of the business, the phone number of the business, the total of the receipt, the date of the receipt, and more.
operations.summary: Recognize a photo of a receipt, extract key business information
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] image ocr photo recognize receipt [PATH] ocr photo recognize receipt [PARAMS] language [SCHEMA] receipt recognition result

operations.description: Converts a photo of a document or receipt in common formats such as JPEG, PNG into words/text with location information and other metdata via Optical Character Recognition.  This API is intended to be run on photographs of documents.  If you want to OCR scanned documents (e.g. taken with a scanner), be sure to use the image/toText API instead, as it is designed for that use case.
operations.summary: Convert a photo of a document or receipt into words with location
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] image ocr photo words with location [PATH] ocr photo to words with location [PARAMS] diagnostics language preprocessing [SCHEMA] element location ocr photo result text to with words

operations.description: Converts an uploaded photo of a document in common formats such as JPEG, PNG into text via Optical Character Recognition.  This API is intended to be run on photos of documents, e.g. taken with a smartphone and supports cases where other content, such as a desk, are in the frame and the camera is crooked.  If you want to OCR a scanned image, use the image/toText API call instead as it is designed for scanned images.
operations.summary: Convert a photo of a document into text
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] image ocr photo to text [PATH] ocr photo to text [PARAMS] language [SCHEMA] image response text to

operations.description: Perform an adaptive binarization algorithm on the input image to prepare it for further OCR operations.
operations.summary: Convert an image of text into a binarized (light and dark) view
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] preprocessing binarize [PATH] ocr preprocessing image binarize [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Perform an advanced adaptive, Deep Learning-based binarization algorithm on the input image to prepare it for further OCR operations.  Provides enhanced accuracy than adaptive binarization.  Image will be upsampled to 300 DPI if it has a DPI below 300.
operations.summary: Convert an image of text into a binary (light and dark) view with ML
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] preprocessing binarize advanced [PATH] ocr preprocessing image binarize advanced [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Analyzes a photo or image of a document and identifies the rotation angle of the page.

operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] preprocessing page angle [PATH] ocr preprocessing image page angle [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] angle page result

operations.description: Detect and unrotate an image of a document (e.g. that was scanned at an angle).  Great for document scanning applications; once unskewed, this image is perfect for converting to PDF using the Convert API or optical character recognition using the OCR API.
operations.summary: Detect and unrotate a document image
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] preprocessing unrotate [PATH] ocr preprocessing image unrotate [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Detect and unskew a photo of a document (e.g. taken on a cell phone) into a perfectly square image.  Great for document scanning applications; once unskewed, this image is perfect for converting to PDF using the Convert API or optical character recognition using the OCR API.
operations.summary: Detect and unskew a photo of a document
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] preprocessing unskew [PATH] ocr preprocessing image unskew [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Leverage Deep Learning to automatically turn a photo of a receipt into a CSV file containing the structured information from the receipt.
operations.summary: Convert a photo of a receipt into a CSV file containing structured information from the receipt
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] receipts photo to csv [PATH] ocr receipts photo to csv [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]
